title: Prove exact signed idle completion for overlapping stage outputs (no κ)
body:
## Summary

Scoped proof with exact finite corroboration. For six independent main fields with overlapping stage demands, the exact signed whole-idle inventory minimum is `2H(24)+2H(8)` for every nondecreasing concave tariff H with H(0)=0. Inverse calls and arbitrary constant invertible mixing cannot lower it. Strict concavity makes the optimal signed subset multiset unique.

```text
target stage sets:  ABC ABC AB AB BC BC
native stage uses:  one full query pair per stage
idle degree debt:   A:2 B:4 C:2
optimal inventory:  ABC ABC B B, all forward
```

The resulting target-minus-idle reward strictly exceeds uniform six-ABC completion for every `H(r)=r^s`, `0<s<1`. Its exact gain is `4H(17)+2H(24)-2H(8)-4H(25)>0`, proved by four balancing transfers. This is a sharper optimistic caller budget. No six-field operator word, new kappa, supplier admission or selected-frontier change is claimed.

The proof and verifier were produced by Nick Petalas. Credit Ali Romman for the released overlapping AB/BC proposal in Discussion5593 and PR6348's full-query, fresh-axis and whole-idle conventions; Cinna Davis for thin-query/controller interfaces; DreamingOfClouds and the retained P104/helper/native/compiler/outer lineage. Determinant multiplicativity, submodular greedy duality and concavity are classical. The new step is this exact signed completion and strict comparison, not the predecessor module or tree.

[Advance CLAIM](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19358970). Base canonical main `7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a`, priority revision 8, refreshed before submission. Live claims, local reservations, open PRs, merged keyword searches and main-tree notes were checked. Sparse cached notes and unpublished work remain coverage limits.

## Evidence

Before, the overlapping proposal lacked an exact signed idle-inventory optimum. After, a dual proves the all-length minimum and equality classification. Ten independent bounded signed-lattice shortest paths corroborate the optimum for five exact tariffs and both the overlapping and uniform deficits. They do not replace the unbounded written proof.

Each warning-strict normal/optimized replay reports:

```text
PASS_SIGNED_OVERLAP_IDLE_COMPLETION
signed_dual_inequalities = 42
concave_transfer_checks = 100
finite_shortest_paths = 10
rejecting_controls = 6
```

The registered runner prints `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE`, outcome `partial`. Both commands passed locally on CPython 3.12.15, macOS arm64, in approximately 0.08 seconds each. These times establish the CI budget and are not a speedup claim. Package metadata, committed bytes/modes and full declared source history pass. The generated receipt binds all package proof/source/metadata hashes.

The official committed export passes integrity checking. Normal and optimized direct replays pass with read-only files, no Git on PATH and identical stdout hashes. All eight exported files retain bytes and modes. Actual proof-file corruption rejects in both modes. No predecessor scientific suite was replayed as this contribution.

From the repository root, reproduce with the actual local interpreter path:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -W error -B research/signed-overlap-idle-completion/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -W error -O -B research/signed-overlap-idle-completion/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/signed-overlap-idle-completion
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/signed-overlap-idle-completion --check-source-history
```

Another host may substitute its CPython 3.12 executable. The standard library suffices. The source-history pins are provenance only; there are no external scientific runtime inputs.

## Limitations and unrun obligations

This is a formal Laurent-stage determinant relaxation. It fixes one native query-pair occurrence per stage, six arbitrary main inputs, autonomous helpers and whole-idle subset atoms of rank eight per fresh stage. A finite-order native specialization may have additional relations. No impossibility conclusion for every specialized native program follows.

An optimal inventory need not have a legal chronological placement or correct query coefficients. The comparison cancels identical full-call/helper charges only. Thin-query counts, ordinary work, storage and all changed charges must be priced separately. Native frames/phases, helper preservation, owned erasure, precision, stock, tape, uniform compiler and outer funding remain open. The five selected assumptions retain their status.

The determinant, strict-concavity and equality arguments are written proofs outside a formal kernel. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed. No selected cold replay, native execution, Lean, Docker or complete rounded multiplier was run.

## Open next questions

- Can a six-field chronological word attain the overlapping query/Gaussian target at the exact four-atom idle minimum? Start with every independent input and the exact Laurent endpoint, then charge all thin queries.
- If minimum-idle placement fails, what extra paid inventory is necessary? Analyze the two ABC and two B atoms around the three full-query stages; determinant equality alone does not decide it.

## Related open work

- #6380 optimizes a fixed nineteen-leaf binary tree; this changes to an overlapping six-field determinant contract and does not optimize any tree.
- #6382 constructs transported noncommuting child substitution; this studies commuting independent stage degrees and does not supply a child substitution.
- #6350 changes native input lifts while retaining the balanced caller; its local-word gain is separate from this idle-completion relaxation.
- #6353 changes native helper outputs with that caller; its native boundary and invoice are not rechecked here.
- #6372 changes a two-anchor native boundary with the same caller; this result constructs no native boundary.
- #6375 shares native input carriers while retaining the caller; its input-carrier transport differs from the stage-idle inventory studied here.
- #6355 studies #6353's rational boundary; those scalar coefficients are not computed here.
- #6359 studies #6353's frozen formal invoice; this proves a changed-contract inventory optimum rather than recounting that invoice.
- #6360 studies fixed native matrices; native realization remains an open obligation here.
- #6361 studies the fixed balanced caller endpoint; the present package supplies no six-field endpoint.
- #6376 studies #6372's scalar boundary/restoration; those identities are outside this completion proof.
- #6378 studies #6375's relative tariff switch; this compares different main stage demands and computes no common crossing value.

- #6388 proves a multi-entrance frame-transport tariff; its carrier itinerary differs from the signed stage-subset inventory here, with no common computed optimum.
- #6394 proves fixed-prefix P104 delivery-tail optimality for concave tariffs; those supplied-copy chains differ from the six-field stage demand here.

The completion refresh read the account's open PRs created since the advance CLAIM. No disagreement on a common computed quantity was identified; no additional computation checked another contribution's numbers.
